title: YN SMP
description: Welcome to the YN SMP! A semi-anarchy server with quality of life mods like Simple Voice Chat and our own RankMod!
body:
- Welcome to the YN SMP, were the only rule is: No insults or inflicting harm on anyone or thing according to Mojang Usage Guidelines!
  
- In this semi-anarchy server, we have went through history building factions and destroying them through war, so join us in the YN SMP to have a hell of a time!
 
- Join our friend's SMP [Empire-Smp-ikt5.aternos.me]!
